claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tubastatin A is a highly selective HDAC6 inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity, since its annotated pharmacology is cytostatic/neuroprotective rather than broadly cytotoxic and no class in the vocabulary captures HDAC6-selective inhibition.
